10. Directly below the heading, add a legend with exactly 2 entries: 'Steel' with a gray (#808080) circle marker and 'Wood' with a brown (#8B4513) circle marker; legend text in black (#000000).
11. In the right column, middle, add the model box: a rectangle with light yellow (#FFFFCC) fill and a thin border (color unspecified, use black [?]) containing 3 lines: 'Model' in bold red (#FF0000), 'I/P: Length, Weight' in black (#000000), 'O/P: Class Type' in black (#000000).
